about_the_game:
Escape or Die is a psychological horror experience where every shadow hides a lie — and every truth comes at a cost.

You play as a determined journalist searching for his missing colleagues Hashir and Irfan. When the game begins, a chilling radio broadcast announces their disappearance. Armed only with a knife, you step into a nightmarish investigation… only to find that the evidence begins to point back at you.

But this isn’t just a story you watch unfold — it’s a story you live. Your role is to survive in the hideout, explore unsettling locations, and uncover pieces of the mystery. With each new revelation, your perception of events begins to twist. Are you the hero seeking justice, or the monster hiding from it?

A lurking threat stalks the dark — the killer clown. Whether it’s a supernatural entity or something far more human, you won’t know until it’s too late. Fear will blur the line between reality and hallucination, forcing you to question who’s really pulling the strings.

Key Features:

  • Immersive first-person psychological horror

  • Deep, branching narrative where nothing is as it seems

  • Chilling atmosphere with sudden, mind-bending horror events

  • Mysterious killer clown — creature, man, or your own reflection?

  • Gradual unraveling of a dark truth that connects all three journalists

  • Tense exploration and survival gameplay in the hideout and beyond

Can you uncover the truth… or will the truth uncover you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
